programme.title: Historical files
programme.desc: Delve into the compelling historical narrative surrounding Patrice Lumumba, an iconic figure of African independence, and the establishment of the Peoples' Friendship University in Moscow. Through direct personal testimonies and immersive on-the-ground reporting, discover the inspiring resilience of individuals striving to overcome modern societal hurdles and create lasting change within their communities

programme.title: UEFA Nations League Live
programme.desc: S2 E6 — Spain v EnglandSpain v England (Kick-off 7.45pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match in Group A3, held at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid. The teams last met in the opening round of fixtures in September, when world champions Spain fought back from 2-1 down to claim a 3-2 win at Wembley Stadium. It was the first meeting between the nations since the UEFA Euro 2024 final in Berlin, which the Spaniards won 2-1, but the Three Lions will be hopeful of avoiding a third defeat in a row to Luis de la Fuente's men, having been in good form since their loss in London. With commentary by Sam Matterface and Lee Dixon, analysis from Roy Keane and Ian Wright, and reports by Gabriel Clarke.

programme.title: The Runaway Train
programme.desc: 1985. Action. Directed by Andrey Konchalovskiy. Stars Jon Voight, Eric Roberts And Rebecca De Mornay. Two escaped convicts and a railway worker find themselves trapped on an out of control train. [S]

programme.title: A Saint, A Woman, A Devil
programme.desc: 1977. Drama. Director: Peter Savage. Stars Joanna Bell, Marc Stevens And Sonny Landham. Sylvia is a seemingly quiet and saintly person. But she is hiding a promiscuous multiple personality disorder. [S]

programme.title: To The Four Corners
programme.desc: 1956. Directed by Eric Marquis. From Kilkeel in Northern Ireland to Lincoln Cathedral, travel across the four corners of the United Kingdom in 1956.

programme.title: One Step Beyond

programme.title: The Atomic Submarine
programme.desc: 1959. Sci-fi. Directed by Spencer Gordon Bennet. Stars Arthur Franz And Dick Foran. A submarine is sent out to investigate a series of naval disasters, but the crew also get caught up in the chaos. [S]

programme.title: Dial 999
programme.desc: 77 Bus. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Robert Cawdron And Ivan Craig. Police are baffled by robberies known as 'the Red Rose series'; Maguire and his partner suspect a seemingly innocent jeweller. [S]

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Shoeless Engineer. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford And Archie Duncan. Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson encounter an injured man carrying an unconscious woman. [S]

programme.title: Twist or Stick
programme.desc: It's a 1960s twisting compilation see 'The Hollies' Shane Fenton And The Fentones, The Orchids, The Keytones, a lot of 'That Old Yeah, Yeah Feeling' and much more.

programme.title: The Four Feathers (1939)
programme.desc: 1939. Adventure. Director: Zoltan Korda. Stars John Clements, Ralph Richardson And C. Aubrey Smith. A British officer seeks to redeem his cowardice 'feathers' by secretly aiding his former comrades. [S]

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trail Blazer
programme.desc: 1956. Western. Directed by Albert C. Gannaway And Ismael Rodríguez. Stars Bruce Bennett And Lon Chaney Jr. Frontiersman Daniel Boone and his family fight for survival when his settlement is attacked. [S]

programme.title: The Railway Children
programme.desc: 2000. Drama. Directed by Catherine Morshead. Stars Jenny Agutter And Richard Attenborough. Three children are forced to move to Yorkshire with their mother after their father is falsely imprisoned. [S]

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: The Phantom of the Farmyard. 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake, Clare Richards. Mrs. Price is lonely in London and wants to move in with the family, so they hatch a plan to put her off. [S]

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: Bowling. Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl And Jack Smethurst. Ada's convinced that the baby is overdue, and Walter gambles his months pension. (S4, E02) [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Birds and the Bees Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum And Ahna Capri. THRUSH has developed a strain of tiny but deadly bees and plans to release them in U.N.C.L.E. HQ in New York. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Mike and Noel bring a touch of magic with amazing 1950s card tricks, then a visit to The Chelsea Flower Show in the 50s and there's a reel of Scottish football fans heading to the Empire Stadium. [S]

programme.title: Enemy At The Door
programme.desc: Treason. 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall, Joss Ackland And Emily Richard. General Von Wittke comes to Guernsey, ostensibly to write a report on the Occupation. [S]

programme.title: Ring of Spies
programme.desc: 1964. Drama. Director: Robert Tronson. Stars Bernard Lee, William Sylvester, David Kossoff And Margaret Tyzack. A secret agent asks Henry Houghton to steal military secrets in exchange for money. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life Why All The Rush
programme.desc: ...Why All The Rush. 1961. A look into why August Bank Holiday is traditionally the date around which most Britons fix their holidays. Those who think they will get away from it all are in for a shock

programme.title: Fox
programme.desc: Fox: Big 'F' - Family. 1980. Stars Elizabeth Spriggs, Derrick O'Connor, Rosemary Martin. The Fox family drifts apart without Billy's guidance and support, and the brothers are facing big problems. [S]

programme.title: What Ever Happened To Aunt Alice
programme.desc: 1969. Drama. Directed by Lee H. Katzin. Stars Ruth Gordon, Geraldine Page And Robert Fuller. Alice applies for the job of housekeeper in order to find out what happened to a missing widowed friend. [S]

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Night of the Shooting Stars
programme.desc: 1982. Drama. Director: Paolo Taviani, Vittorio Taviani. Stars Margarita Lozano And Omero Antonutti. While watching shooting stars, Cecilia recounts when her Tuscan town defied their Nazi occupiers. [S]

programme.title: A Yank In Ermine
programme.desc: 1955. Comedy. An American air-man (Peter Thompson) inherits an English title but will he cope with English nobility? Starring Jon Pertwee and Sid James. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Isabella. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Zena Walker, Helen Cherry And Donald Pleasence. Princess Avice summons Robin for help after discovering her husband is planning to marry a French princess. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Sunken Temple. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell And Greydon Gould. Despite warnings from locals, the Supercar team explore an underwater temple only to find out why they were warned. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Man in Demand. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Dorothy Gordon And Enid Lorimer. A young wife finds her marriage in danger due to her mother in law's excessive demands on her son. [S]

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: The Trap. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West. [S]

programme.title: The Doorway to Hell
programme.desc: 1930. Crime Drama. Director: Archie Mayo. Stars James Cagney, Lew Ayres And Dorothy Mathews. A crime lord decides to retire and stay away from the underworld, but certain events force him to return. [S]

programme.title: A Tale of Five Cities
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Stars Bonar Colleano, Barbara Kelly, Eva Bartok And Gina Lollobrigida. An Englishman leaves America to enlist in the RAF, but a drunken accident results in a loss of memory. [S]

programme.title: Z-Cars

programme.title: Echo Of Diana
programme.desc: 1963. Joan is distraught at the death of her husband in a plane crash but all is not what it seems. Stars: Vincent Ball And Betty McDowall. [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November. [S]

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart

programme.title: The Small Back Room

programme.title: The Cruel Sea
